summary: Saul inquires of the witch of Endor for revelation—She foretells his death, the death of his sons, and the defeat of Israel by the Philistines.
meta_description: Saul inquires of the witch of Endor for revelation—She foretells his death, the death of his sons, and the defeat of Israel by the Philistines.

footnotes.note3_a: IE he had banished spiritualists as required by Lev. 20:27; Deut. 18:9–11.
footnotes.note7_a: TG Spirits, Evil or Unclean; Superstitions.
footnotes.note14_a: This cannot be a bona fide vision from God, brought about by a spiritualist medium. See v. 15. Its effect was to destroy all hope. See v. 20; 31:1–4.
